neighbours.label: the token ' console' (game console or terminal console) and similar device-type nouns ('kit', 'Model')
fire: The new handheld console sold out in most shops within a week.

My parents bought me a game console for my twelfth birthday.
Type the command into the console and press enter to run it.
The company hopes its next console will outsell the competition.
Error messages are printed to the console while the server runs.
He keeps an old console from the nineties in his living room.
Log in to the admin console to change the backup settings.
quiet: The new handheld device sold out in most shops within a week.
Open the browser window and check for red error messages.
My parents bought me a new bicycle for my twelfth birthday.
Type the command into the terminal and press enter to run it.
The company hopes its next phone will outsell the competition.
